description: Defines classes, structs, and functions for managing PUCCH resource collisions in a 5G NR scheduler, including collision matrices, multiplexing regions, and resource allocation logic.

classes.name: pucch_grants
classes.description: Represents the time-frequency grants of a PUCCH resource, including overlap checking.

classes.name: resource_info
classes.description: Holds information about a PUCCH resource, including format, multiplexing index, and grants.

classes.name: pucch_collision_manager
classes.description: Manages PUCCH resource collisions, allocations, and deallocations within a cell.

methods.name: make_cell_resource_list
methods.description: Computes the list of all PUCCH resources based on cell configuration.

methods.name: make_collision_matrix
methods.description: Computes the collision matrix indicating resource overlaps.

methods.name: make_mux_regions_matrix
methods.description: Computes the multiplexing regions matrix for resources.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::pucch_collision_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collision manager with cell configuration.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal state based on slot indication.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::alloc_common
methods.description: Allocates a common PUCCH resource at a specified slot.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::alloc_ded
methods.description: Allocates a dedicated PUCCH resource at a specified slot.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::free_common
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated common PUCCH resource.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager::free_ded
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated dedicated PUCCH resource.
